notes: Improved: Guest information, rental agreement and invoice PDFs have a new look, with one letterhead, a summary of the stay at the top, and full-width sections.
Improved: PDFs show the booking date, and any notes appear as additional information.
Improved: The guest information PDF shows agreements and checks in a clear checklist, and charges and payments together with the balance due.
New: The invoice now exports as a PDF, with an invoice number and date.
New: The rental agreement exports as a PDF. If it isn't signed yet, it has blank lines for signing.
Improved: The Print buttons on contracts and invoices are now Export buttons.
New: Photo ID can be marked as "Not checked" again if you marked it by mistake.
Fixed: Occupant ages of 0 now show on the PDF.
